reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used supplement bottles, and I don't need another one I'll stop taking after a week. One form of magnesium for $25 to $30 a month doesn't feel special when other products pack several forms into one capsule.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others have 8 forms in one capsule? And I'd be paying monthly for something I'll probably quit, plus Made in China makes me a bit wary even with the lab report.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing it fixing my exact sleep problem, plus a lower price like $19.99 for the first box.
